description: Front and back with the sleeves cut in one with the body, joined at the shoulders and sides; trimmed neckline, folded hem at the hips. The simplest construction; the front has no bust shaping.
name: Short-sleeved top (cut-on sleeves)

description: Front, back and two tube sleeves set into round armholes, with an underarm seam on each sleeve; the usual construction for a fitted top.
name: Top with set-in sleeves

description: Diagonal raglan seams from the neckline to the armpits, so each sleeve includes the top of the shoulder; easy to fit across the shoulders.
name: Raglan top

description: Cut-on sleeves with princess seams from the shoulders over the bust to the hem: a centre front and two side fronts that shape the bust.
name: Princess-seam top

description: One piece per leg, joined at centre front and back, with an inside-leg seam; folded waist hem.
name: Leggings

description: Neck to wrists and ankles in four pieces, with a back zip from neck to crotch and seams over and under the arms, down the sides and the inside legs.
name: Catsuit

description: Left and right fronts and backs, two set-in sleeves and a diamond crotch gusset where the centre and inside-leg seams meet; back zip.
name: Catsuit with set-in sleeves and gusset

description: Underbust to hips in four pieces with a back zip; both edges trimmed.
name: Waist cincher
